# THE PLANE DOCTRINE (capability_equality.rs, plane_isomorphism.rs) — data, so the test sources
# name no plugin.
#
# plane <column>: the owner's directional plane list, verbatim — the five planes (llm, mcp, a2a,
# streaming, decisions; U14), each a single column when it declares needs in one direction alone
# (llm, decisions) and counted in both directions otherwise. Must equal qa/capability-equality.json
# `planes`.
plane llm
plane decisions
plane mcp-client
plane mcp-server
plane a2a-client
plane a2a-server
plane streaming-client
plane streaming-server
#
# dialect <name>: a plane's dialect, never a column (U14: `voice` is the streaming plane's).
dialect voice
#
# root-leg <leg> <cargo feature that compiles it into this build>: the six root legs. Must equal
# qa/capability-equality.json `root_legs`. The mcp, a2a and voice legs are the served kernel-loop
# rider (the voice leg its session rider), so the feature that links the plane gates them.
root-leg root-a2a plane-a2a
root-leg root-admin root-admin
root-leg root-llm proto-llm
root-leg root-mcp plane-mcp
root-leg root-voice plane-streaming
root-leg root-decisions plane-decisions
#
# crate <crates/busbar-<suffix>> <ledger column>...: the columns each workspace plane crate answers
# to (both halves of every plane; plane-streaming is the plane voice is a dialect of).
crate llm llm
# (`crate mcp` STRUCK, P3 DEL-MCP, ARCHITECT 2026-10-05: crates/busbar-mcp is deleted; the mcp plane is
# `plane-mcp` below.)
crate a2a a2a-client a2a-server
crate voice streaming-client streaming-server
crate plane-llm llm
crate plane-mcp mcp-client mcp-server
crate plane-a2a a2a-client a2a-server
crate plane-streaming streaming-client streaming-server
crate plane-decisions decisions
#
# owed <crate suffix>: workspace plane crates that answer to no ledger column yet, pinned exactly
# (none since U14 gave the decisions plane its column).
#
# installed <plane key> <ledger column>...: the doctrine's installed-plane axis (plane_isomorphism.rs)
# — each plane the composition root installs from its own linked entry, and the directional ledger
# column(s) it answers to.
installed llm llm
# (`installed mcp` STRUCK, P3 DEL-MCP, ARCHITECT 2026-10-05: the mcp plane is served through its
# memory-ABI door alone and installs no PlaneDecl, so it is not on the reflected axis; its columns are
# still answered by the `root-mcp` leg.)
installed a2a a2a-client a2a-server
installed streaming streaming-client streaming-server
#
# owned-section <plane key> <declaring section> <owned section>...: the linked planes that own the
# grammar of a top-level section, and those sections (plane_owned_sections_boot.rs).
# (`owned-section mcp tools mcp` STRUCK, P3 DEL-MCP, ARCHITECT 2026-10-05: these rows pin the LINKED
# PlaneDecl planes' owned sections, and the mcp plane installs no PlaneDecl any more. Its `tools` /
# `mcp` sections are declared by its door's Statement, which the config-schema gate reads as a
# door-only plane's declaration (xtask/src/gates/config_schema/declared.rs).)
owned-section streaming streams streams
